decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic natural yogurt line that extends the firm's core organic dairy capabilities, supplier relationships and established Demeter positioning, it fits very strongly with its absorptive capacity and is unlikely to be withdrawn within a year.

This mild sliced cheese is close to the firm's long-standing cheesemaking know-how and customer base, so management can readily interpret market feedback and improve or adjust it rather than remove it quickly.

Sliced butter cheese also builds directly on the firm's existing cheese expertise, processing assets and retail offering, making retention more likely than withdrawal even though it is still a relatively new 2024 launch.
